<div class="t-wrap"><p class="t-intro">I teach marketing, consumer behaviour, digital marketing and quantitative research methods, in English, from first-year undergraduates to doctoral candidates. My courses are built around real market problems: students write complete marketing plans, design digital strategies with the SOSTAC model, and analyse how culture, technology and social influence shape what people buy. At doctoral level I teach the methods I use in my own research, multivariate analysis and structural equation modelling.</p><nav class="t-strip" aria-label="Institutions"><a href="#gdansk-tech"
